import tempfile,pathlib,subprocess
p=max(pathlib.Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).glob('opencut-ff-preservation-*'),key=lambda x:x.stat().st_mtime)
print('Toy:',p)
for args in [['log','--oneline','--all','--decorate'],['status','--short'],['diff','--cached','--stat']]:
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),*args],text=True,capture_output=True)
 print(args,r.returncode,r.stdout[-5000:],r.stderr[-1000:])
